resources.string: Read or copy this analysis. The selected text will not be replaced.
Unlock your device to open AI provider settings.

Use your own API key. Keys are encrypted on this device and excluded from backups and exports. Cloud actions require a separate, explicit send from the text preview. Ordinary typing stays offline. API charges and the provider’s data policy apply.
A key is stored on this device.
Enter a key with at most 4,096 ASCII characters, without spaces or line breaks.
Could not access secure storage. Unlock the device and try again. If the stored key is damaged, delete it and enter it again. Secure keys require Android 6 or later.
Model saved. No API request was sent.
Hold space to open the wheel
Optional. Space swipes and custom popup keys keep their actions. Hold the language key to switch keyboards, or use Android’s keyboard switcher.
Customize your keyboard in the existing settings, then save a profile for each area. Applying a profile changes only that area.
Key style, borders and font size. Colors and custom themes remain available in Appearance.
Number row, emoji key and language key. Manage languages and custom layout files under Languages and layouts.
Horizontal and vertical space swipes and swipe-to-delete.
Reset this area to its defaults? Your saved profile is kept.
Replace the saved profile for this area with your current settings?
This profile could not be saved or applied. It may be damaged or belong to a different version.
Case and spacing tools work on your device. AI actions require a separate send. Tap a preview to expand it.
Select text in the app first, then open text actions.
Review the result before replacing your selection.
Empty result: applying removes the selected text.
The text or selection changed. Reopen text actions to start again.
Text actions are disabled in this protected field.
Finish typing or swiping, then select text.
The editor may have accepted the result. Check the text before doing anything else. Closing this panel may close the keyboard so it can reconnect.
%3$s: send the previewed selection (%2$d characters) to %4$s using %1$s? API charges and the provider’s data policy apply.
Action cancelled. No result will be inserted. A request already sent may still incur charges.
Set up your API key under AI providers, then reselect your text and start again.
The provider rejected this key or its permissions. Check AI providers, then start again.
The model or request was not accepted. Check the model ID under AI providers.
The provider’s rate or usage limit was reached. No retry was sent.
The request timed out. No retry was sent. A request already received may still incur charges.
The provider declined this action. No replacement is prepared.
The response was incomplete, invalid or too large. No replacement is prepared.
An earlier request is still stopping. Reopen the panel to try again.
The request failed. No retry was sent. Check your connection or provider and reopen the panel.

Assign actions to the three numbered keys and pin them to the toolbar. If the toolbar is hidden, enable it in Toolbar settings. Each key prepares a preview; AI still needs a separate Send. Language, tone and model come from AI provider settings.
Could not read or save these keys. Unlock the device and reopen this page. An invalid import leaves your configuration unchanged.
No skill is available for this key. Unlock the device or assign it under Skill keys in app settings.
Skill assignments imported. No action was executed.
Saved profile imported. Tap Apply saved to change the keyboard.
Export contains the three names and action assignments. Import replaces these three assignments, without changing pinned keys or running actions. API keys, text and results are excluded.
Up to 20 status records for seven days, encrypted on this device. Source texts and results are not retained. A restart never repeats a request or inserts text.
Action status could not be saved or read. No new request is sent if its initial status cannot be saved. You can delete the status records and try again.
Response received. Editor insertion is always a separate action; the response is not saved here.
Cancelled locally. The provider may already have processed the request.
Outcome unknown. No automatic retry or text insertion.
Combine local and AI text actions. Files contain configuration only. Saving or importing never executes an action.
The workflow could not be read or saved. Its configuration may have changed. Cancel the draft and refresh before editing again.
Activate %1$d imported workflows and replace the saved collection? This does not run any action.
Workflow configuration activated. No action was executed.
Choose a workflow. Nothing runs until you approve the complete sequence.
This sequence runs locally. Its result is only a preview; text insertion remains a separate action.
Up to %1$d model requests. The declared selection and intermediate results are sent to the providers above. API charges and provider data policies apply. Nothing is automatically inserted.
Running workflow… Nothing is automatically inserted.
This workflow requires a provider that is not available. No request was sent.
Workflow stopped: text or output exceeded its allowed limits. No partial result was inserted.
input has at least %1$d UTF-16 characters
When a condition is false, that step passes its input through unchanged and makes no model request.
Workflow finished: %1$d model requests, %2$d skipped steps.
Literal comparison, including case. No regular expressions.
The referenced workflow is unavailable. Import it or choose another in settings.
This key stores a workflow reference. Pressing it opens the current saved definition for separate approval. Workflow files are exported separately.
Up to %1$d steps and %2$d model requests. Text and time limits also apply.
Workflow finished. Inserting text is a separate action. Results are not retained here.
Builder response received. Saving a workflow is a separate action.
Delete the damaged workflow configuration and start with an empty list? Saved workflows will be lost. API keys, profiles and skill bindings are kept; workflow references may need reassignment.
Describe a text workflow using local transformations, AI text actions and conditions. Maximum 8 steps and 3 model calls.
This exact instruction and the fixed workflow format will be sent to OpenAI using the model shown. No editor selection is included. API usage may incur costs.
The builder is unavailable. Unlock the device and leave incognito mode before trying again.
Review every step and model before saving. This draft is not saved yet. Saving adds configuration; start the workflow separately from the keyboard.
Test tool (on this device): counts the characters, words and lines of the %1$d selected characters. Nothing leaves the keyboard and nothing is inserted.

Hand over to: the calendar app you choose (Android “new event” screen).
The keyboard does not save an event and cannot see whether you save one there.

Title: %1$s

Description (%2$d characters):
%3$s
Running tool… Nothing is automatically inserted.
Test tool finished on this device. The selected text is unchanged.
Handed over to the calendar app. The event is not saved until you save it there.
No app accepted the calendar draft. Nothing was handed over.
The tool failed. Nothing is repeated automatically.
This selection cannot be used with the tool.
Tool cancelled. Nothing was handed over.
Test tool finished on this device.
Handed over to another app. Whether anything was saved there is not known.
Enter a model ID for this provider under AI providers first.
Provider for the keyboard’s AI actions
The key and model below belong to the selected provider. Workflow steps name their own provider.
No model is preset for this provider. Enter the model ID from the provider’s documentation.
What the keyboard learns from your typing stays on this device. It is never sent to an AI provider, and generated or inserted text is not learned.
Learning from typing is off (Text correction → Personalized suggestions). Switching it off deletes what was learned.
While paused, nothing new is learned and no word is added to your personal dictionary. What was learned before stays and is still used for suggestions.
Writes a readable JSON file to a place you choose. The file contains words you typed; keep it private.
Delete everything the keyboard learned from your typing, for all languages? Your personal dictionary is not changed. This cannot be undone.
That did not work. Nothing was changed or exported.
The answer was too long and was discarded. Nothing is inserted. Try a shorter selection.
A step of this workflow has a model ID its provider cannot use. Edit the workflow. No request was sent.

Dictation uses only the recognizer that Android provides for on-device speech recognition (Android 12 or newer). The recognition is done by that system service, not by the keyboard. The keyboard never uses Android’s general recognizer, which may send audio to a server; if on-device recognition is missing, dictation is simply unavailable. What was heard is shown first and is inserted only when you tap “Insert at cursor”. Dictated text is not learned.
On-device speech recognition is not available on this device. Dictation stays off; nothing is sent anywhere.
The microphone is allowed for dictation.
The microphone is not allowed yet.
Android did not grant the microphone. If no dialog appeared, allow it in the system settings of this app (Permissions → Microphone).

Start dictation with the “Dictate” button in text actions, or add the “Dictate (on device)” key under Toolbar. Put the cursor where the text should go, without selecting anything. The language follows the keyboard language; its speech pack must be installed in the system’s speech settings.
Listening on this device… Tap “Done” when you have finished speaking. Nothing is inserted yet.
Check the text. It is inserted at the cursor only when you tap the button.
Dictation cancelled. The microphone is off and nothing was inserted.
Allow the microphone first: Settings → Dictation.
On-device recognition cannot use the keyboard language on this device: it is not supported or its speech pack is not installed (system speech settings).
Nothing was understood. The microphone is off.
The speech recognizer is busy. Try again in a moment.
Dictation failed. The microphone is off and nothing was inserted.
The dictation is too long to insert. Dictate a shorter part.
Dictation inserts at the cursor. Tap where the text should go, without selecting text.
Dictation needs a normal text field.
Finish the current word first (for example with a space), then dictate.
Finishing… The text appears in a moment. Nothing is inserted yet.

Black background, flat grey keys, pill-shaped Enter and ?123 keys, number row and symbol hints. Sets style, colors, icons, rows and sizes for portrait in one step. The values from before you first applied it are kept until you restore them.

A correct word is never replaced automatically by one that differs only by an umlaut (mochte/möchte, schon/schön). The other word is still suggested. Exception: a pair you taught it yourself with \"Learn my typos\".
Only words that are not in the dictionary are corrected automatically. Everything else is only suggested.
If you press backspace right after an automatic correction, this pair is never applied automatically again. Stored only on this device, not in incognito mode, not while learning is paused.
Forget all remembered corrections? They can be corrected automatically again.

If you pick a different word from the suggestion strip after typing, the keyboard counts this pair. After three equal picks it corrects it automatically; a word that exists itself only after the same previous word. Stored only on this device.
Learned typos: %1$d, confirmed at least three times: %2$d

The keyboard learns where you really hit each letter key, from the calibration and from words you type, and moves the invisible touch area a little towards it. The keys you see stay where they are. A zone moves at most a third of a key. Only averages per key are stored, on this device, no text.
Type the text below as you normally do, with this keyboard. Typos do not matter; you can also stop earlier.
Too few letters to say anything yet. Type a little more.

After you take a screenshot, the keyboard shows it as a small chip in the strip for three minutes. The chip only appears in fields that accept images; tapping it inserts the image there. Nothing is inserted without your tap. The chip does not appear in password and number fields, in incognito mode or while the device is locked. The keyboard only looks for new images in screenshot folders and sends nothing anywhere.
Offer new screenshots in the strip
Access to images is not allowed yet. Without it there is no chip.
Android did not grant access. If no dialog appeared, allow it in this app\'s system settings (Permissions → Photos and videos). With access to selected photos only, new screenshots are not visible.
Only selected photos are allowed. New screenshots are not among them, so there is no chip. Allow all photos in this app\'s system settings (Permissions → Photos and videos).

Type a command at the start of a word, e.g. %1$smath. The strip then shows chips instead of word suggestions; only a tap on a chip removes the command text and runs it. A bare %1$s lists all commands. Mail addresses and mentions do not trigger anything. Commands are off in password fields, in incognito mode and while the device is locked. Command words are neither corrected nor learned.
Only characters that do not end a word can be used, so the autocorrection leaves the command alone.
No root of a negative number
The field changed. Nothing was inserted.
Calculator: computes on the device and inserts the calculation, the result, LaTeX or x²/½ notation. %smath 12*3,5 starts with that calculation.
The text before the cursor changed. Nothing was replaced.

Contacts: %scontact Ann shows matching contacts from the phone\'s address book (synced Google contacts included). A tap shows name, phone numbers, mail and postal addresses, another tap inserts one as text. Read on the device only, only while you type the command; needs access to contacts.
Opens the command settings to allow access to contacts
%s needs access to contacts, which is not allowed yet.
Android did not grant the access. If no dialog appeared, allow it in the system settings of this app (Permissions → Contacts).
Choose a theme from preview tiles
The Flat look also sets rows, sizes and the toolbar. Keyboard profiles can restore the look from before.
Web search: %ssuch term opens a web search for the term in the default search app or browser (otherwise DuckDuckGo). Only after a tap on the chip; the term then leaves the keyboard.
No app can open a web search.
Special characters by name, on the device: %szeichen pfeil offers → ← ↑ ↓, also English names like arrow or degree.
Emojis by keyword, on the device: %semoji daumen offers 👍 👎, also English keywords like heart or dog.
Unit conversion on the device: %1$sconv 5 oz or %1$sconv 100 f. Length, mass, volume (US cups and spoons), temperature and speed, no currencies. “in” picks the target: 5 oz in g.
Web address: %1$surl heise.de opens the address in the browser. %1$surl alone suggests addresses from the field and the clipboard and, if switched on, from the screen.
No app can open this address.
No web address on the screen.
The screen could not be read.
Agent Keyboard: read screen on command
Reads the visible text once when you tap “Read screen” after @url.

Reads the text that is currently visible only when you type @url and tap “Read screen”, finds web addresses in it and shows them as chips. It listens to no events, so it does nothing in between and uses no battery. Password fields and the keyboard itself are skipped. What is read stays in memory only for these chips; it is never stored, logged or sent.

With %1$surl alone, the chip “Read screen” can find web addresses on the screen of the current app. For this the keyboard needs an accessibility service. It reads only when you tap the chip, once, skips password fields and keeps nothing: no storage, no log, no internet. It listens to no events and does not run in between.

If the switch is greyed out (Xiaomi, Android 13 and newer, apps not installed from a store): open App info of this keyboard, tap the menu with the three dots and choose “Allow restricted settings”, then switch the service on.
